description: This file is a web page for troubleshooting and performing reset/restore operations on a network gateway device. It includes UI elements, JavaScript for handling user interactions, and server-side PHP includes.

methods.name: setResetInfo
methods.description: Sends reset or restore commands to the server and handles UI updates based on server response.

methods.name: checkForRebooting
methods.description: Checks if the device has rebooted by polling the index.php page and redirects to login upon success.
